title: Fusion EA: ZZ swing breakout lines + engulfing entry, grid-step martingale with hedge overflow
entry_long: price breaks above ZZ-derived swing-high line (LINE_buy, H1 zigzag depth20) enabling buy-mode, then bullish engulfing forms inside an ICT zone (3-candle downswing body-sum>=100pips) -> open buy 0.01 lot group1
entry_short: mirror: price breaks below ZZ swing-low line (LINE_sell) enabling sell-mode, then bearish engulfing inside ICT sell zone -> open sell 0.01 lot group2
exit: grid/reverse-train adds every 100pips; trailing stop 150pips/step5 once >=2 orders in a group; rebalanced group close at total profit >=100pips; no SL/TP on individual orders
escalation_cap: Max_Order=15 per side then switches to fixed-lot 0.05 hedge (heading) orders opened every candle (author admits grid-spacing bug: hedge fires every bar not every grid step, unintentionally aggressive)
buildon_idea: already capped at 15 orders before switching to hedge; fix the hedge-grid bug (author's own admission) by referencing the correct group in the noted-nearby distance block so heading only fires every 100pips instead of every bar; also test linear-add instead of step lot increase
novelty_note: combines two prior fxDreema examples (140+143) plus a hedge/heading overflow mode; multi-group ZZ-line breakout entry is somewhat distinctive but base martingale-grid engine is common across this channel's series

title: Multi scalping EA: dual-timeframe RSI (H1 filter, M5 trigger) with step martingale grid
entry_long: H1 RSI<30 sets buy-mode; then M5 RSI(7)<30 confirms -> open buy 0.01 lot group1 (2-timeframe confirmation)
entry_short: H1 RSI>70 sets sell-mode; then M5 RSI(7)>70 confirms -> open sell 0.01 lot group2
exit: grid/for-train adds every 10pips when in profit direction with trailing stop 15pips/step1 after >=2 orders; rebalance close when unrealized profit >5 USD across both groups; no SL/TP on orders
escalation_cap: L_Plus=0.01 per 5-order step (uncapped max-order stated by narrator; only a save-mode Max_Order=10 exists but is disabled by default)
buildon_idea: add explicit hard Max_Order cap in live mode (not just optional safe-mode) and test linear-add lot law instead of step-martingale; distance-close ($5) could scale with equity for better realism
novelty_note: dual-timeframe RSI confirmation is a clean simple filter mechanism, reusable across other candidate entries; base engine is the same recurring martingale-grid chassis

title: H1_M1_Nexus_Scalper: H1 RSI zone gate + M1 EMA3/EMA8 alignment with distance filter, ATR-adaptive trailing, equity cut-loss
symbol: unspecified (gold-style pip sizing implied, likely XAUUSD)
entry_long: H1 RSI<30 permits buy; M1 EMA3>EMA8 (uptrend alignment) and price-to-EMA3 distance <=60pips (not overextended) -> open buy 0.01 lot group1
entry_short: H1 RSI>70 permits sell; M1 EMA3<EMA8 and distance<=60pips -> open sell group2
exit: grid adds every 100pips; ATR-scaled trailing stop (base 60pips x ATR-adjust factor) once >=2 orders; hard equity cut-loss at -30% of starting balance ($3000 on $10000 account) closing both groups
escalation_cap: Max_Order=50 per side (hard cap before cut-loss logic), plus step lot increase every 5 orders
buildon_idea: already capped (50 orders + equity cut-loss); the ATR-adaptive trailing-stop distance is a reusable module worth extracting into other EAs' exit logic independent of this entry; test tighter distance filter for gold volatility
novelty_note: ATR-adaptive trailing stop distance (adjusts telling_stop width by current ATR) is a genuinely reusable improvement over the fixed-pip trailing seen in sibling examples

title: Multi scouting EA: RSI level (30/70) gated bullish/bearish engulfing entry with grid-step martingale
entry_long: RSI(14)<30 then bullish engulfing (id2 bearish candle body, id1 bullish candle closing above id2 open) -> open buy 0.02 lot group1
entry_short: RSI(14)>70 then bearish engulfing (id2 bullish, id1 bearish closing below id2 open) -> open sell 0.02 lot group2
exit: grid/for-train adds every 20pips; trailing stop 10pips/step1 once >=2 orders; rebalance close when combined profit >$10; no SL/TP on individual orders
escalation_cap: L_Plus=0.01 per 5-order step counter (no explicit hard Max_Order cap stated in this transcript)
buildon_idea: add explicit hard order cap (sibling examples used 10-50); the 5.75-year backtest (2019-2024, 736 orders, MaxDD 27.4%) is unusually long-window evidence worth cross-checking against lab's 3-year window rule before reuse
novelty_note: same RSI-level+engulfing entry pattern reused across this channel's series; distinguishing feature is the unusually long multi-year backtest the narrator shows

title: Multi scouting EA: dual EMA(5/25) cross confirmed by doji reversal candle entry, grid-step martingale
entry_long: EMA5 crosses above EMA25 at id1, AND (id2 or id3) is a large bullish candle breaking through both EMAs in one bar, AND id1 is a doji with lower wick > upper wick and > body, with candle low below EMA_fast -> open buy 0.02 lot group1
entry_short: mirror: EMA5 crosses below EMA25, large bearish candle breaks both EMAs, id1 is doji with upper wick > lower wick and > body, high above EMA_fast -> open sell 0.02 lot group2
exit: grid/for-train adds every 20pips; trailing stop 10pips/step1 once >=2 orders; rebalance close at total profit >5pips; no SL/TP on orders
escalation_cap: L_Plus=0.01 per 5-order step counter (no explicit hard Max_Order cap stated)
buildon_idea: add explicit hard order cap (sibling EX147/EX145 used 10-50); narrator himself flags this EA as high-risk (MaxDD 65.4% on $10k, needs $3000 deposit bump to reach 'low-risk' bracket) - a clean candidate for testing linear-add lot law and adding a hard cap before any further use
novelty_note: dual-EMA-cross + doji-confirmation entry filter; same martingale-grid chassis as siblings but author explicitly flags this variant as NOT low-risk unlike others in the series

title: 148-v2 for gold: EMA cross zone-persistent doji entries (not single-point) + reversal-confirmation before grid-add
entry_long: signal_ema flag stays ON for the whole EMA5>EMA25 uptrend window (activated once by a large breakout candle, not just at the cross point) -> any doji forming while flag is on triggers a new buy 0.02 lot group1 (allows repeated entries per trend leg, not just one)
entry_short: mirror using signal_emas flag during EMA5<EMA25 downtrend window plus doji with long upper wick
exit: grid/for-train adds every 100pips with trailing stop 60pips/step1; NEW: before adding a grid/averaging leg, requires a simple reversal-candle confirmation (id2 opposite-direction candle then id1 reversal) rather than adding immediately on distance alone; rebalance close at total profit >5pips
escalation_cap: L_Plus=0.01 per 5-order step counter (no explicit hard Max_Order cap stated); author notes MaxDD 72.5% on $10k account, recommends doubling deposit to de-risk
buildon_idea: the reversal-confirmation-before-averaging idea (wait for a small reversal signal before adding a martingale leg, rather than adding purely on fixed-distance) is a reusable risk-reduction module worth extracting into other grid EAs in this catalog; still needs a hard order cap - author admits parameters are unoptimized and risk is elevated (72.5% DD) versus the v1 (EX148 nV_F7S_FSRw)
novelty_note: the persistent-signal-window entry (trade any doji throughout the trend, not just at the EMA cross) plus pre-averaging reversal confirmation are both incremental improvements over the base EX148 mechanism worth cataloging separately

title: Go Robot rebalancing strategy: fixed SL/TP first trade, win=same-direction restart at base lot, loss=reverse-direction double lot (anti-martingale rebalance)
entry_long: no condition - opens first trade as buy unconditionally with SL500/TP500 pips; after any buy TP-win, reopens buy at base lot (0.01); after any buy SL-loss, reopens as sell at 2x lot
entry_short: triggered only as the loss-response leg: after a losing trade in either direction, opens opposite direction at double the prior lot size (rebalancing toward the trend); after a sell TP-win, reopens sell at base lot
exit: fixed SL/TP 500 pips per order, no grid/trailing; consecutive-loss counter (15) terminates the EA entirely (manual restart required) as the risk cap
escalation_cap: lot doubles (lot_x=2) on every loss, capped indirectly by consecutive_loss=15 hard-stop (EA self-terminates) and Volume_Upper_Limit=100 lots
buildon_idea: already capped via consecutive-loss=15 self-terminate; test replacing the 2x doubling with linear-add or a capped-step schedule to reduce tail risk while keeping the win-streak-resets-to-base-lot mechanic, which is the genuinely useful part (anti-martingale rebalancing back toward the dominant trend direction)
novelty_note: distinctive mechanism vs the rest of the series - simple fixed SL/TP with direction-reversal-on-loss (doubling) and reset-to-base-on-win, explicitly designed as a lot-pumping/scouting EA rather than a grid-averaging system; author reports this concept came from a student combining ideas from examples 97 and 116
